title: Khujjasobhita

  • Tikanipāta The Book of the Threes
  • Paṭhamavagga Chapter One

Khujjasobhitattheragāthā Khujjasobhita

“Ye cittakathī bahussutā, “One of those monks who live in Pāṭaliputta— Samaṇā pāṭaliputtavāsino; such brilliant speakers, and very learned— Tesaññataroyamāyuvā, stands at the door: Dvāre tiṭṭhati khujjasobhito”. the old man, Khujjasobhita.

“Ye cittakathī bahussutā, One of those monks who live in Pāṭaliputta— Samaṇā pāṭaliputtavāsino; such brilliant speakers, and very learned— Tesaññataroyamāyuvā, stands at the door: Dvāre tiṭṭhati māluterito”. an old man, shivering in the gale.”

“Suyuddhena suyiṭṭhena, “By war well fought, by sacrifice well made, saṅgāmavijayena ca; by victory in battle; Brahmacariyānuciṇṇena, by leading the spiritual life: evāyaṁ sukhamedhatī”ti. that’s how one prospers in happiness.”

… Khujjasobhito thero ….
